channel.title: The Coin Wire
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and protocol upgrades: what changed, and what comes next.

item.title: Utexo plans to bring USDT back to Bitcoin through RGB
item.description: Tether-backed Utexo plans to issue USDT on Bitcoin via RGB this month, reviving the token’s original network while testing a more private payment model.

item.title: Why a Wrapped Bridge Token May Not Redeem Yet
item.description: A wrapped bridge token is redeemable only through the route and contract that issued it; delays, liquidity gaps and paused bridges explain many failures.

item.title: A Swap Is Not Complete When the First Chain Says Success
item.description: Tracking an omnichain swap links source confirmation to destination execution, showing route progress and why one transaction hash alone cannot prove delivery.

item.title: BaseSwap on Base: swaps and liquidity carry different risks
item.description: BaseSwap lets Base users swap tokens or supply liquidity; the choice turns on convenience versus pool risk, and on what providers need to track after depositing.

item.title: SEC proposes conditional crypto self-custody for advisers and funds
item.description: SEC proposal would let advisers and funds self-custody some crypto when no qualified custodian is available, with controls and board oversight.

item.title: Is Chainflip Right for Your Cross-Chain Swap?
item.description: Chainflip swaps native assets across chains without wrapped tokens, but the right route depends on custody, asset availability and how much coordination a swap requires.

item.title: FCA opens crypto authorisation gateway ahead of 2027 rules
item.description: The FCA opened crypto authorisation on 30 September, giving firms until February to seek approval before broader rules take effect in October 2027.
